notes: Fanless desktop (wall/table-mount) unit, not rack-mountable; dimensions 210 x 140 x 40mm (WxDxH), 965g. Official Netgear "Hardware-at-a-Glance" table (M4250_Datasheet.pdf, p.2) lists this model's data ports as "8 ports PoE+ (110W) / 1 additional port" (RJ45) + "1 port SFP 1G", plus a separate rear "Ethernet: 1G Out-of-band" management port, front USB-C console, and rear USB-A storage port — confirmed against Netgear's product page and the installation guide (which independently confirms the Type-C USB console port and OOB/service port terminology). Exact front-panel port labels/numbering are inferred from product photography (not individually confirmed via a labeled panel diagram) — device may print them as "1-8", "9", "SFP1"/similar rather than these exact strings. The power connector is inferred as a DC barrel jack based on Netgear's "External Power Adapter (130W)" wording and rear-panel product photos showing a round jack; the exact barrel diameter/pin configuration (e.g., possible locking type) is not stated in the sources reviewed. SFP port left ungraded per instructions since the grade scale for RJ45/etherCON was not extended to SFP in this task's rules, even though the SFP cage is 1G-rated (1000BASE-X). A sibling model, GSM4210PX (M4250-8G2XF-PoE+), shares this same chassis/desktop form factor but has 2x SFP+ (1G/10G) instead of 1x SFP + 1x extra RJ45 — do not confuse the two.
